messages:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY ALERT FIRED -> prod-prometheus-scrape-failure (sev=P1). >80% prometheus targets DOWN + log_ingest_lag spike. Paged @maria.

maria: ack — i'm on it. pinging @jon and @maya for prometheus + logging triage.

jon: i'm looking at /targets now. quick check: a bunch of exporters returning 503 and connection refused. could be network/routing or exporter crash.

tim: FYI there was a small routing config rollout ~16:40 UTC. @deploy-bot, did that touch metrics routing?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router config rollout completed at 16:42 UTC across us-east region. no rollout errors recorded in the pipeline.

maya: checking logging pipeline — vector shows backpressure and repeated 5xx to s3 sink. kinesis retries piling up. switching to fallback sink now.

jon: running quick target query to surface failures:
```
curl -sS http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | select(.health!="up") | {scrapeUrl, labels: .labels.__name, health, lastError}'
```

maya: executing restart on vector deployment in logging namespace and tailing logs:
```
kubectl -n logging rollout restart deployment/vector
kubectl -n logging logs -l app=vector --tail=200
```
restarting now, will monitor backlog metric.

maria: noticed three hosts with disk usage >90% which were failing node-exporter scrapes. freed space and restarted node-exporter DS on those hosts (`kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart daemonset/node-exporter`).

jon: after restarts, target UP count climbed from ~40% -> ~98% across the cluster. still seeing elevated `log_ingest_lag_seconds` (~900s avg 15m). that's the metric driving alert.

maya: failover to alt-s3 endpoint completed, ingestion rate improving. temporarily increased log-ingest worker replicas (4 -> 8) to drain backlog.

maria: PD acknowledged 1743010001. keeping as P1 until metrics stable for 30m and backlog drains.

lena: escalating/covering next steps. re-run alert queries in 10m and post results here. tagging dashboard owners for any stale visualizations.

tim: double-checking customer-facing systems — no API/response errors reported. impact appears limited to monitoring/observability (dashboards stale, alert noise). recommend muting noisy downstream alerts until this resolves.

maya: mitigation summary: restarted vector pods, enabled sink failover, increased workers, cleared disk pressure on exporters. backlog is draining — ingestion rate up ~3x.

jon: tentative root cause hypothesis: transient router rollout + disk pressure on a small set of hosts caused exporters to fail and upstream ingest to backpressure. adding a follow-up runbook item to make exporter disk usage alerts more aggressive.

maria: handing off active monitoring to @lena for the next 30m. notes left: restarted vector, restarted node-exporter on 3 hosts, failover sink enabled, increased log workers. will update PD timeline and close when stable. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident note appended to PD: "Prometheus scrapes and log ingestion lag. Mitigations executed: exporter restarts, vector restart, sink failover, increased workers. Monitoring ongoing."

ops-bot: ops-bot: created follow-up ticket #SRE-3247 -> "Investigate exporter disk pressure during router rollouts" and linked to this PD incident.
